ios.desc:
Supercharge your AWS career with AWSary, the all-in-one companion app for cloud professionals, students, and community members. Whether you’re preparing for certifications, staying up to date with the latest AWS news, or connecting with the global AWS community, AWSary gives you the tools to accelerate your cloud journey.

Key Features
• AWS Knowledge Hub – Explore clear, concise explanations of AWS services, written to help you learn and retain key concepts.
• Certification Pathways – Track your learning journey, map out your next certification, and stay motivated with guided paths.
• Community Highlights – Discover fresh content from AWS Heroes, Community Builders, User Groups, and Cloud Clubs worldwide.
• Stay Current – Get quick updates, tips, and insights to keep your AWS skills sharp.
• Career Growth – Use AWSary to plan your next step, find inspiration, and accelerate your progress in the cloud.

Designed with modern aesthetics, AWSary feels at home on your iPhone and iPad, blending sleek design with practical features.

Whether you’re just starting with AWS or already certified across multiple specialties, AWSary is your trusted companion to learn, grow, and connect in the AWS ecosystem.

Privacy policy: https://tig.pt/awsary-privacy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

Hi, I made an AWS dictionary that help quickly check an AWS service, basics of Pricing and some Facts.

It also helps drawing AWS architectures by allowing to drag and drop this AWS services icons to other apps like Apple Notes or Freeform.

Everything is opensource https://github.com/tigpt/AWSary

I would to get some feedback to keep improving it. Thanks
